"White symbol of three nested rising arcs beside the extended, squared geometric sans wordmark ARCHI-TEX, shown over a muted steel-frame construction photo."
"Caution Orange #ef4723, Solid White #ffffff and Coal Black #231f20."
"Manifold Extd CF, a wide, squared-off geometric sans shown in Thin, Regular, Medium and Bold with italics."
"Dark social profile card framed in orange: a steel-frame construction header photo, an orange square avatar with black nested arcs and the name Archi-Tex."
"Roadside billboard: orange panel with stacked ARCHI TEX, a black arc symbol and a service list, beside a photo of two hard-hat workers on steel stairs."
"Heavy rounded lowercase wordmark asteor with a TM in white on near-black, the a drawn as a dot plus a curved stroke."
"Obsidian Ink #1E1E1E (primary), Ultramarine Pigment #004AAD, Zinc Chartreuse #E7F67F, Cadmium Crimson #C91414 and Acrylic Blossom pink #FFA1F9."
"Cinqcent, a heavy, rounded display sans with quirky letterforms, shown in Light, Regular, Medium and Bold."
"One profile card labeled Art Studio on black: a chartreuse as monogram on a black avatar under a blurred blue abstract banner, with a blue Follow button."
"Two framed posters on a dark slatted wall, each a vivid surreal portrait illustration in purple, pink, orange and teal with the asteor logo below."
"Half-asterisk symbol of one vertical and two diagonal strokes on a base bar, beside the two-line sans wordmark Astrix Builders; white over a site photo."
"Light sky blue AACFDF, bright orange F24E24 and deep navy 0B2639, with white, shown beside a crane photo and short taglines."
"Geist, a clean, neutral sans, shown in Regular, Medium and Semi Bold."
"Profile card on light sky blue: a banner of stacked concrete blocks, an orange circular avatar with the white symbol and the tagline A Legacy Of Excellence."
"Wall billboard with three panels: a navy panel with a timber-structure photo, a hard-hat worker on a forklift, and an orange panel with a tagline and logo."
"Dusty rose caps wordmark AURAIC with TM in a wide geometric sans, A's without crossbars; the first A has a curved left leg and a four-point sparkle."
"Velour Crimson #AE5969 (primary), Soft Gold #D5B39B and Ethereal Rose #F2BFC8, each with a row of tints and shades."
"Godber, a light, wide display face with sans-like forms and stylized curves, shown from Extra Light to Bold."
"Facebook-style page on a black rocky backdrop: a red-pink banner with LUXURY and skincare bottles, and a round avatar with a stylized A."
"Bus-shelter ad on a city street: a beige-to-pink gradient poster with the AURAIC logo, large outlined LUXURY text and a script tagline."
"White geometric sans wordmark Aurox with a TM on navy, the A drawn as an open chevron with no crossbar."
"Cart Alert Orange #FF6D00 (primary), Hyperlink Blue #145DFF, Midnight Void navy #11142F, Direct-Red #E6222B and Eco-Growth Green #96C828."
"Satoshi, a geometric sans, shown in Light, Regular, Medium, Bold and Black."
"One profile card labeled Ecommerce and Shopping on an orange background: an orange avatar with the white A mark under a soft orange-and-yellow gradient banner."
"Large orange screen in a dark hall reading Shop Smarter. Live Better Everyday., with a 3D man in a chair amid products; a traveler with a suitcase walks past."
"Black italic sans wordmark AutoNex with a capital N, set large on a light gray background."
"Bright red #EF3737, cool gray #B0BEC5, near-black #121212 and off-white #ECEFF1."
"Satoshi, a geometric sans, in Regular and Bold."
"Dark profile card with a header photo of a mechanic beside a red-lit car, a red-ringed avatar with the AN mark and a bio about vehicle service and repair."
"Framed poster on a dark wall over a wet street at night: a mechanic leaning into an engine bay, with PROFESSIONAL CARE FOR EVERY VEHICLE in red and white."
"White lowercase wordmark avelo in a rounded, squared geometric style with a registered mark, on deep navy."
"Expedition Blue #3042DD (primary), Midnight Transit navy #030436, Terracotta Trail #B71F06, Solar Horizon orange and Skyway Tint light blue #83B9FF."
"Ragdit, a wide, rounded-square geometric sans with a techno feel, shown in Light, Regular, Medium and Bold."
"One profile card labeled Travel and Tour on navy: an airliner in clouds as the banner, with a blue avatar bearing a white av monogram."
"Wall billboard in a dark hall: a turquoise lagoon with limestone cliffs and a longtail boat, headline Discover the World Seamlessly and the avelo logo."
"White interlocking loop knot in an oval above the thin, wide caps wordmark AVOOVA, where the knot replaces the OO; shown on a navy-to-red gradient."
"Obsidian Navy #0B1F3A (primary), Velocity Red #E40013, Circuit Volt yellow #FFF307, Hyper Cobalt #0057FF and Aero Frost pale blue #C5E2F9."
"A wide geometric display typeface labeled OQYGEN, with crossbarless A shapes, shown in Light, Regular, Medium and Bold."
"One profile card labeled Mobility, EV Car and E-Bike on a red-orange gradient: a red sedan in a white studio as the banner and a red avatar with the white knot."
"Billboard on a brick street building: ELECTRIC BY NATURE. in navy caps beside a silver sedan, a red swoosh and the AVOOVA logo."
